purpose: Bounded benchmark of running multiple corrected U1 sonar effective-batch workers on one NVIDIA L4

five_worker_attempt.reason: After about 7.5 minutes, workers were still dominated by disk I/O wait during setup and GPU memory/use remained effectively idle.
five_worker_attempt.observed_worker_state: D/R with folio_wait_bit_common, jbd2_log_wait_commit, or rq_qos_wait
five_worker_attempt.recommendation: Do not use five concurrent independent workers on this snapshot-backed boot disk without changing storage/layout.

projection.scope: Neutral projection only; this does not make the benchmark promotable.
projection.note: Two-worker packing improves wall-clock and cost projection versus the single-worker measured rate, but still exceeds the approved combined P4-P10 cap before P4.12, storage, reruns, and P5-P10.

conclusion.next_action_without_budget_change: No full P4 launch; continue only with smaller benchmarks or implementation work.
conclusion.next_action_with_budget_change: Run promotable branches with at most two concurrent workers per L4, after each branch's formal gate is unblocked.
